rollback.archivePolicy: Git history and this annotated tag are the archive; no legacy directory is created.

scope.purpose: Remove only confirmed retired platform paths and quarantine the reachable frozen legacy monitor.

inventory.deletionListCanonicalization: Lexicographically sorted repository-relative paths, UTF-8, one LF-terminated path per line.

before.build: TypeScript, research transport, Phase 8A, both frontends, Phase 8C, cockpit inertness and Phase 8D1 supply-chain checks

after.start:cockpit: node dist/cockpit-main.js (explicit loopback-only, read-only Phase 8A evidence viewer)
after.build: TypeScript, research transport, Phase 8A, Research Cockpit and cockpit inertness checks; no frozen paper dashboard or retired deployment verification

removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Tracked GitHub workflows; verify ran on selected pushes and publish/recovery were manually dispatchable.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Exact workflow allowlisting, least privilege and fail-closed validation remain in the ordinary CI policy; target-specific image publication/recovery evidence is archived by the rollback tag.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: The workflows exclusively validate, publish or recover cancelled Phase 8D/GHCR images; ordinary CI and Roadmap Sync remain unchanged.

removalGroups.subsystem: Phase 8C/8D deployment and GHCR supply chain
removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Reached only by retired workflows, retired package verification scripts and implementation-coupled tests.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Future deployment must retain immutable identity, pinned digests, non-root/read-only/cap-drop/no-new-privileges/no-host-socket isolation, bounded resources, explicit ingress, secret exclusion, rollback and fail-closed partial publication.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: All code and contracts are coupled to the cancelled TrueNAS/GHCR image target; no V2 deployment is built in B2A.

removalGroups.subsystem: root V1 runtime and TrueNAS packaging
removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: The root image starts dist/main.js and the YAML/shell assets deploy or reinstall the frozen TrueNAS runtime.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Source identity, default-deny runtime configuration and rollback requirements are preserved as V2 requirements; no reusable target implementation is selected.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: Each asset is exclusively tied to the frozen scanner image or retired TrueNAS topology; its target-specific implementation is retired and its target-neutral safeguards are migrated to the named active records.

removalGroups.subsystem: TrueNAS deployment, monitoring and mutation helpers
removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Not called by retained code; directly address the retired host, app, secret path, container log or V1 deployment state.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Host/route/method allowlisting before credential access and content-integrity checks remain requirements. The pinned HTTPS helper is TrueNAS-specific and lacks the content hash and run-budget contract needed for OF1, so it is not reused.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: Read-only reachability inspection found hard-coded TrueNAS/LAN paths or direct V1 runtime operations in every listed helper; their target-neutral allowlist/integrity requirements are migrated to the named active records.

removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Documentation and repository-policy requirement only; Hermes is not an active development or deployment boundary.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Strict YAML parsing, exact workflow structure, read-only permissions, source review and safe-default checks already live in neutral active policy code and tests.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: The original review trail remains immutable under the rollback tag; no unique active requirement depends on a Hermes-branded path.

removalGroups.subsystem: retired deployment and placeholder analytics documentation
removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Retired documents remained linked for transition history but were not V2 authority.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Canonical/rebuildable analytics, provenance, evidence, coverage, quarantine and deployment isolation requirements are present in active V2 documents; obsolete available_at terminology is not migrated.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: The documents define cancelled TrueNAS/GHCR/Grafana/ClickHouse-first targets and are preserved under the rollback tag.

removalGroups.subsystem: Phase 8C placeholder ClickHouse/Grafana and V1 forensic dashboards
removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Reached only by retired tests/docs and inactive provisioning; no authentic V2 dataset feeds these assets.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Evidence, source, decoder/schema/code identities, coverage, quarantine and causal timestamps remain active requirements. Phase 8A event-transport evidence is retained separately.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: The removed assets are design-only or V1 forensic projections; ClickHouse is not canonical and no permanent server is introduced.

removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Previously wired to dashboard POST controls; after the control routes are removed it has no external owner and only maintains always-on local toggles.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: None; scan accounting remains in the ledger/scan cycle and provider-specific isolated tests remain available.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: The dashboard mutation route and frontend controls are removed; keeping an unreachable mutable bus would be misleading dead code.

removalGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Invoked by the default build solely to validate Phase 8C deployment contracts.
removalGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Research transport, Phase 8A offline, cockpit inertness and ordinary CI gates remain independently enforced.
removalGroups.reviewEvidence: The hook has no responsibility outside the cancelled Phase 8C deployment target.

testClassifications.subsystem: Phase 8D1 image publication and recovery tests
testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered these tests; they imported Phase 8D1 scripts/contracts or asserted retired image and recovery workflows.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Target-neutral deployment isolation and publication integrity requirements migrate to active architecture documentation; target-specific fixtures are not V2 golden oracles.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: All nineteen tests import Phase 8D1 scripts/contracts or assert retired image/recovery workflows.

testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered these tests; they required the cancelled Phase 8C image/deployment contracts.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: No unique target-neutral invariant beyond retained safety and provenance rules.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: The tests assert only cancelled Phase 8C deployment contracts.

testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered this test; it required retired Phase 8C documents to remain in the active tree.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: None; it requires retired document references to remain active.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: The test contradicts the approved removal outcome.

testClassifications.subsystem: Phase 8C ClickHouse-first and TrueNAS packaging tests
testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered these tests; their assertions selected a cancelled canonical-storage or deployment target.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: ClickHouse must be rebuildable and noncanonical; provenance/evidence remains explicit. The old tests instead require ClickHouse-first or TrueNAS/root-Docker target behavior.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: Their expected target or timestamp model is incompatible with the accepted V2 contract.

testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered this test; it spawned a TrueNAS-specific helper and asserted the retired TrueNAS/root-image packaging contract.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Network host/route/method allowlisting must occur before credential access; default provider paths remain disabled.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: The executable helper and test are bound to a retired TrueNAS address and credential path.

testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered this test; it required a permanent in-tree V1 dashboard archive.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Git history and the annotated tag replace an in-tree V1 dashboard archive.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: The test asserts the presence of the in-tree archive that B2A deliberately removes.

testClassifications.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary Vitest discovered this test; it validated inactive Grafana contracts and dashboards that had no authentic V2 data source.
testClassifications.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Static snapshots must not claim rates/deltas; replay-only rate panels require explicit bounded replay evidence.
testClassifications.reviewEvidence: The full Grafana suite is placeholder infrastructure; two evidence-mode invariants remain useful and are moved to the retained Phase 8A test.

retainedGroups.subsystem: frozen V1 domain source and quarantined optional monitor
retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: The frozen runtime was a default package launch target and its dashboard exposed unauthenticated mutation controls on a non-loopback default bind.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: B2A retains the domain source for later invariant-by-invariant replacement, removes default launch commands and mutation controls, and forces any direct monitor construction/preview to loopback read-only operation.
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: The retained source is frozen evidence, not the V2 product; no package-manager default starts it and no HTTP mutation route remains.

retainedGroups.subsystem: explicit Phase 8A evidence monitor and transport-inert build boundary
retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: The explicit start:cockpit command and retained offline CI/build gates use these paths.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Loopback-only GET/HEAD serving, bounded immutable input reads, transport denial, source-side non-influence and graceful bounded shutdown remain required until authentic Observatory parity exists.
destination: B6 authentic Research Observatory parity gate
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: This is the one explicit monitor retained by B2A; it imports no scanner/provider/wallet path and remains fixture-only evidence.

retainedGroups.subsystem: Old Faithful/Pump research specifications and source/activation evidence
retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Historical contract tests, offline citation policy and B3–B5 evidence reconstruction depend on these bounded records.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Pinned source identities, explicit activation uncertainty, fixture-only status, coverage semantics and transport-free adapter constraints remain inputs to the versioned V2 walking skeleton.
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: Explicit retention contract; these files are evidence/specification, not provider-call authorization or authentic V2 data.

retainedGroups.subsystem: non-default legacy live/debug/profile diagnostics outside B2A's bounded retirement set
retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: No retained package script or workflow launches these files; some are network-capable and therefore remain non-authorized legacy artifacts pending a dedicated reachability review.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: None accepted as V2 evidence; retention prevents an unreviewed broad deletion and does not authorize execution.
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: The B2A scope explicitly forbids broad deletion of live/debug/profile scripts unless a file is proven exclusively tied to the retired target.

retainedGroups.subsystem: protocol, exact-integer, WAL/checkpoint and deterministic replay evidence
retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Ordinary CI and research policy gates.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Golden vectors, ordering, exact integers, provenance, quarantine, WAL, checkpoint, crash recovery and deterministic replay.
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: Explicit retention contract; no parity replacement exists yet.

retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Retained explicit loopback-only evidence viewer and offline CI.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Read-only bounded APIs, explicit UNAVAILABLE/fixture status, no provider/scanner/wallet imports and source-side non-influence.
destination: B6 authentic Research Observatory parity gate
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: Explicit B2A retention; authentic replacement has not yet proven parity.

retainedGroups.subsystem: ordinary CI and GitHub Project governance
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Trusted-main exact reconciliation, lifecycle retention, migration evidence and build gates.
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: Explicit retention contract and active Project #4 control.

retainedGroups.subsystem: offline immutable V1 forensic manifest evidence
retainedGroups.reachabilityBeforeRemoval: Offline test only; no deployment or network entrypoint.
retainedGroups.uniqueInvariantOrEvidence: Stable file reads, no-symlink inputs and immutable forensic evidence classification.
retainedGroups.reviewEvidence: Not part of the retired active platform target and explicitly bounded to forensic evidence.
